## UI/UX Pro Max

Searchable design guidance for palettes, typography, accessibility, and frontend stacks.

提供可检索的配色、字体、无障碍与多技术栈界面设计指导。

**Source / 来源:** [nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill) · [SKILL.md](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill/blob/main/.claude/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md) · [reviewed revision](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill/blob/a38d04c3d5c298c851dbe5e6ee1965ee3de42cb5/.claude/skills/ui-ux-pro-max/SKILL.md)

**Use when / 适用场景**

- Choose a coherent palette and type system.
- Review responsive interactions and accessibility for a frontend stack.

- 选择一致的配色与字体系统。
- 审查特定前端技术栈的响应式交互和无障碍体验。

**Install / 安装**

```text
npm install -g ui-ux-pro-max-cli
uipro init --ai codex
```

[Upstream instructions / 上游安装说明](https://github.com/nextlevelbuilder/ui-ux-pro-max-skill#installation)

Run from your project root. The example targets Codex; upstream also documents --ai claude and --ai cursor. Node.js/npm and Python 3 are prerequisites. The CLI supplies platform-specific files and supporting data.
